text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It came as soon as the date changed.<n>What a nice
birthday message. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, good. ♪ I'm glad it got to you.<n>Hehe, when I
looked back later, I<n>noticed I typed "gappw
bipthdaw" on<n>accident, though.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I had heard, you see, that all the kids<n>are sending
"happy birthday" right at<n>midnight these days, using
their<n>cellular phones.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You'd gone through all that trouble to<n>teach me how
to send emails, so I<n>figured I'd give it a go.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I saw your message, it made<n>me feel all
snuggly and warm, even in<n>my bed. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, seeing the smile on your face<n>makes it worth
all the while. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right—I made a big batch ofhaskap pickles... for you... yawn...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um, Acute? Are you okay? You look<n>sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm fine, dearie! Just... I'm notnormally up and about so late atnight... Think I... yawn... snooze...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute?! You didn't have to go to all<n>that trouble!
